name: welcome-back
author: Takaro
description: Win back players who were away. When a player connects after being away for at least minDaysAway days (from Takaro's last-seen time), they get a one-time welcome-back reward: currency and optional items, scaled by how long they were gone (tiers such as 7, 30 and 90 days). They get a private message, and optionally the server sees a broadcast. Each absence pays out once. Brand-new players are skipped, the first join belongs to onboarding. The WELCOME_BACK_CLAIM permission gates the reward; its count multiplies the currency for VIPs. Admins run welcomebackstats to see how many players came back each week.
summary: One-time welcome-back reward (currency + optional items, scaled by days away) and a PM when a player returns after being away. Once per absence, skips brand-new players, VIP multiplier via permission count, and a weekly 'players returned' stats command for admins.

minDaysAway.title: Minimum days away
minDaysAway.description: A player must have been away at least this many days to get a welcome-back reward.

tiers.title: Reward tiers
tiers.description: Rewards by days away. The tier with the highest minDays the player reached is used. A player who reached minDaysAway but no tier gets the lowest tier. itemMultiplier multiplies the amount of every configured item (0 = no items for that tier).

items.title: Reward items
items.description: Optional items given on return. The amount is multiplied by the tier's item multiplier. Leave empty for currency only.

message.title: Reward message
message.description: Private message with the reward. Placeholders: {player}, {days}, {reward}, {currency} (currency name), {prefix} (command prefix).
message.default: Welcome back {player}! You were away {days} days. Here's {reward}.

messageNoReward.title: Message without reward
messageNoReward.description: Private message when the player qualifies but gets nothing (no WELCOME_BACK_CLAIM permission, or nothing to give). Leave empty to send nothing. Placeholders: {player}, {days}, {prefix}.
messageNoReward.default: Welcome back {player}! You were away {days} days.

broadcast.title: Broadcast returns
broadcast.description: Tell the whole server when a player comes back.

broadcastMessage.title: Broadcast message
broadcastMessage.description: Server-wide message when broadcast is on. Placeholders: {player}, {days}.
broadcastMessage.default: {player} is back after {days} days away. Welcome back!

permissions.description: Player gets the welcome-back reward after being away. The count multiplies the currency reward (e.g. 2 for VIP doubles it). Give it to the Player role for everyone.
Allows an admin to see how many players returned per week.

welcomebackstats.description: Show how many players came back after being away, per week.
welcomebackstats.helpText: Shows how many players returned (and got a reward) per week. Optional: number of weeks to show (1-26).

welcome-back.description: Gives the welcome-back reward when a player returns after being away.
